decision.reason: Replay the previously compiled and axiom-audited proof after a definitionally equivalent indexed-scope correction; the controller must recompile it against its current dependencies.
decision.proof:
by
  intro U inst K H G α β conjSubgroup Kα Hβ hK hH eα eβ A B J σ hσ
    orbit L a b left right crossingDot dot down up M Mj W straight eval
  have hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G :=
    fun k => hK ⟨k, k.property, rfl⟩
  have hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G :=
    fun h => hH ⟨h, h.property, rfl⟩
  have hA : eα.toHom.range = A := SinglePairIdentitySupport.range_eq_comap α hα
  have hB : eβ.toHom.range = B := SinglePairIdentitySupport.range_eq_comap β hβ
  -- Xiao, §5.1, after Proposition 5.3 (archive p. 18; published
  -- 28 November revision p. 19). No numbered Alphabeta Math proof
  -- is recorded for this endpoint. Steps 1–5 of the obstruction
  -- above follow the orbit-coordinate proof of Proposition 5.3.
  refine ⟨?_, SinglePairIdentitySupport.fiber_clauses K H G α β hα hβ
    A B hA.symm hB.symm σ hσ, ?_⟩
  · intro S ec ed ML WL p ι hpι
    exact SinglePairIdentitySupport.identity_obstruction eα eβ ec ed A B hA hB σ hσ p ι hpι
  · -- The full intersection gives the fiber witness and the labelled
    -- Mackey sum. On a singleton quotient that sum evaluates to its sole
    -- term even at inputs where the pointwise support is empty.
    intro j hj
    obtain ⟨hf, hcancel⟩ :=
      (MixedReidemeisterTwoMackeyCancellation K H G α β hK hH σ hσ).2.2.2
    obtain ⟨finite, _, hsum⟩ := hcancel.2.2
    refine ⟨hf j, ?_⟩
    intro p ι
    let summands (i : J) : MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing Complex M M :=
      MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.vertical
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.compactProjection eα eβ (left i) (right i)
          [(1, ⟨dot i, hf i⟩)])
        (MackeyDiagrams.LabelledDrawing.mixedMultiplication eα eβ (left i) (right i)
          [(1, dot i)])
    let sum : MackeyDiagrams.PointwiseIndexedDrawing Complex M M J := ⟨summands, finite⟩
    have hsum' (x : W.carrier →₀ Complex) : sum.evalAt x = (eval straight).toLinearMap x := hsum x
    apply MackeyDiagrams.Biset.Hom.ext
    apply LinearMap.ext
    intro x
    change (eval (summands j)).toLinearMap x = (eval straight).toLinearMap x
    rw [← hsum' x, MackeyDiagrams.PointwiseIndexedDrawing.evalAt_eq_finsum]
    symm
    exact finsum_eq_single (fun i => (eval (summands i)).toLinearMap x) j
      (fun i hi => (hi (hj i)).elim)
decision.support:
namespace SinglePairIdentitySupport
open MackeyDiagrams
universe u

private theorem range_eq_comap {U : Type u} [Group U] {K G : Subgroup U}
    (α : U) (h : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G) :
    (ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α h).toHom.range =
      Subgroup.comap G.subtype (K.map (MulAut.conj α).toMonoidHom) := by
  ext g
  constructor
  · rintro ⟨k, rfl⟩
    exact ⟨k, k.property, rfl⟩
  · rintro ⟨k, hk, heq⟩
    exact ⟨⟨k, hk⟩, Subtype.ext heq⟩

private theorem identity_obstruction {U : Type u} [Group U] {K H G S : Subgroup U}
    (eα : ConjEmbedding K G) (eβ : ConjEmbedding H G)
    (ea : ConjEmbedding S K) (eb : ConjEmbedding S H)
    (A B : Subgroup G) (hA : eα.toHom.range = A) (hB : eβ.toHom.range = B) :
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let D := Word.down eα
      let I := Word.up eβ
      let X := (Word.tensor D I).basis
      let Y := (Word.tensor (Word.up ea) (Word.down eb)).basis
      ∀ (p : Biset.Hom Complex X Y) (ι : Biset.Hom Complex Y X),
        Biset.Hom.vertical p ι =
          (LabelledDrawing.horizontal (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id D))
            (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id I))).interpret.eval →
        ∃ j₀ : J, ∀ i : J, i = j₀ := by
  intro J σ hσ D I X Y p ι hcomp
  classical
  let j : J := DoubleCoset.mk A B 1
  refine ⟨j, fun i => by_contradiction (fun hij => ?_)⟩
  -- Proposition 5.3 (archive p. 17; published 28 November revision p. 19),
  -- step 1. The registered SinglePairCannotProjectOntoSeveralDoubleCosets
  -- requires a compatible dot. Adapt its orbit-coordinate argument directly
  -- to arbitrary intermediate embeddings and equivariant maps.
  let classOf : X.carrier → J := fun z =>
    DoubleCoset.mk A B (Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ z)
  let coords : (X.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] (J →₀ Complex) :=
    Finsupp.lmapDomain Complex Complex classOf
  have class_act (g : K × H) (z : X.carrier) : classOf (X.act g z) = classOf z := by
    have product_act :
        Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ (X.act g z) =
          eα.toHom g.1 * Generator.mixedProduct eα eβ z * eβ.toHom g.2⁻¹ := by
      refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun xy => ?_)
      change (eα.toHom g.1 * xy.1 * (1 : G)⁻¹) *
          (1 * xy.2 * (eβ.toHom g.2)⁻¹) = eα.toHom g.1 * (xy.1 * xy.2) * eβ.toHom g.2⁻¹
      simp [mul_assoc]
    change DoubleCoset.mk A B _ = DoubleCoset.mk A B _
    exact (DoubleCoset.eq.mpr ⟨eα.toHom g.1, hA ▸ ⟨g.1, rfl⟩,
      eβ.toHom g.2⁻¹, hB ▸ ⟨g.2⁻¹, rfl⟩, product_act⟩).symm
  have coords_action (g : K × H) (v : X.carrier →₀ Complex) :
      coords (X.actLinear Complex g v) = coords v := by
    have h : coords.comp (X.actLinear Complex g) = coords := by
      apply Finsupp.lhom_ext
      intro z r
      simp [coords, class_act]
    exact LinearMap.congr_fun h v
  -- Steps 2–3. The intermediate basis has one orbit, generated by [1,1].
  let Y₁ := Biset.induction ea
  let Y₂ := Biset.restriction eb
  let z₀ : Y.carrier := Y₁.pair Y₂ 1 1
  have orbit (z : Y.carrier) : ∃ g : K × H, Y.act g z₀ = z := by
    refine Quotient.inductionOn z (fun xy => ?_)
    refine ⟨(xy.1, xy.2⁻¹), ?_⟩
    change Y₁.pair Y₂ (xy.1 * 1 * (ea.toHom 1)⁻¹)
      (eb.toHom 1 * 1 * (xy.2⁻¹)⁻¹) = Y₁.pair Y₂ xy.1 xy.2
    simp
  -- Step 4. Equivariance makes every return column have the same orbit coordinates.
  let v₀ := coords (ι.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z₀ 1))
  have coords_column (z : Y.carrier) :
      coords (ι.toLinearMap (Finsupp.single z 1)) = v₀ := by
    obtain ⟨g, hg⟩ := orbit z
    rw [← hg, ← Y.actLinear_single Complex g, ι.commutes, coords_action]
  let aug : (Y.carrier →₀ Complex) →ₗ[Complex] Complex := freeLift Complex (fun _ => 1)
  have factor :
      coords.comp ι.toLinearMap =
        (LinearMap.toSpanSingleton Complex (J →₀ Complex) v₀).comp aug := by
    apply Finsupp.lhom_ext'
    intro z
    apply LinearMap.ext_ring
    simp [aug, coords_column, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply]
  -- Step 5. Each outer class supplies a unit coordinate vector on the identity.
  have orbit_column (k : J) : ∃ c : Complex, c • v₀ = Finsupp.single k 1 := by
    let z : X.carrier := (Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ).symm (σ k)
    have hz : classOf z = k := by
      change DoubleCoset.mk A B ((Generator.mixedEquiv eα eβ) z) = k
      rw [Equiv.apply_symm_apply, hσ]
    let x := Finsupp.single z (1 : Complex)
    have hcol := congrArg (fun f : Biset.Hom Complex X X => f.toLinearMap x) hcomp
    have hstraight : (LabelledDrawing.horizontal
        (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id (R := Complex) D))
        (LabelledDrawing.ordinary (Diagram.id I))).interpret.eval.toLinearMap x = x := by
      have h := Biset.Hom.horizontal_id (R := Complex) D.basis I.basis
      exact congrArg (fun f : Biset.Hom Complex X X => f.toLinearMap x) h
    change ι.toLinearMap (p.toLinearMap x) = _ at hcol
    rw [hstraight] at hcol
    refine ⟨aug (p.toLinearMap x), ?_⟩
    have h := LinearMap.congr_fun factor (p.toLinearMap x)
    change coords (ι.toLinearMap (p.toLinearMap x)) = _ at h
    rw [hcol] at h
    simpa [x, coords, hz, LinearMap.toSpanSingleton_apply] using h.symm
  obtain ⟨ci, hci⟩ := orbit_column i
  obtain ⟨cj, hcj⟩ := orbit_column j
  have hii : ci * v₀ i = 1 := by
    simpa [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul] using congrArg (fun v : J →₀ Complex => v i) hci
  have hji : cj * v₀ i = 0 := by
    simpa [Finsupp.smul_apply, smul_eq_mul, hij, Ne.symm hij] using
      congrArg (fun v : J →₀ Complex => v i) hcj
  have hvi : v₀ i ≠ 0 := by
    intro h
    simp [h] at hii
  have hcj0 : cj = 0 := (mul_eq_zero.mp hji).resolve_right hvi
  have hjj := congrArg (fun v : J →₀ Complex => v j) hcj
  simp [hcj0] at hjj

private theorem fiber_clauses {U : Type u} [Group U]
    (K H G : Subgroup U) (α β : U)
    (hα : ∀ k : K, α * (k : U) * α⁻¹ ∈ G)
    (hβ : ∀ h : H, β * (h : U) * β⁻¹ ∈ G) :
  let conjSubgroup := fun (c : U) (S : Subgroup U) =>
    Subgroup.map (MulEquiv.toMonoidHom (MulAut.conj c)) S
  let Kα := conjSubgroup α K
  let eα := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator α hα
  let eβ := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator β hβ
  ∀ (A B : Subgroup G) (_ : A = eα.toHom.range) (_ : B = eβ.toHom.range),
    let J := DoubleCoset.Quotient (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
    ∀ (σ : J → G) (_ : ∀ j : J, DoubleCoset.mk A B (σ j) = j),
      let orbit := fun j : J => DoubleCoset.doubleCoset (σ j) (A : Set G) (B : Set G)
      let M := Word.tensor (Word.down eα) (Word.up eβ)
      let W := M.basis
      let eval := fun {bottom top : Word K H} (drawing : LabelledDrawing Complex bottom top) =>
        drawing.interpret.eval
      let crossingDot := fun {S : Subgroup U} (c d : U)
          (hc : ∀ ℓ : S, c * (ℓ : U) * c⁻¹ ∈ K)
          (hd : ∀ ℓ : S, d * (ℓ : U) * d⁻¹ ∈ H)
          (hs : (α * c) * (β * d)⁻¹ ∈ G) =>
        show Dot
          (ConjEmbedding.comp eα (ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator c hc))
          (ConjEmbedding.comp eβ (ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator d hd)) from
          Dot.ofRepresentatives (α * c) (β * d)
            (by
              intro ℓ
              change α * (c * (ℓ : U) * c⁻¹) * α⁻¹ = _
              simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
            (by
              intro ℓ
              change β * (d * (ℓ : U) * d⁻¹) * β⁻¹ = _
              simp only [mul_inv_rev, mul_assoc])
            hs
      ∀ (S : Subgroup U) (c d : U)
          (hc : ∀ ℓ : S, c * (ℓ : U) * c⁻¹ ∈ K)
          (hd : ∀ ℓ : S, d * (ℓ : U) * d⁻¹ ∈ H)
          (hs : (α * c) * (β * d)⁻¹ ∈ G),
        let ec := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator c hc
        let ed := ConjEmbedding.ofConjugator d hd
        let δ := crossingDot c d hc hd hs
        let s := Dot.element δ
        let replyDot := Dot.inverse δ
        let ML := Word.tensor (Word.up ec) (Word.down ed)
        let j := DoubleCoset.mk A B s
        let Ls := Kα ⊓ conjSubgroup ((s : U) * β) H
        let finiteIndex := Subgroup.IsFiniteRelIndex (conjSubgroup (α * c) S) Ls
        let q := Generator.mixedMultiplicationBasis eα eβ ec ed δ
        let finiteFibers := ∀ z : W.carrier, Set.Finite {w | q w = z}
        let cupFinite := Subgroup.FiniteIndex (MonoidHom.range (ConjEmbedding.toHom ed))
        let isTransversal := fun T : Set H => ∀ h : H, ∃! t : H,
          t ∈ T ∧ h * t⁻¹ ∈ MonoidHom.range (ConjEmbedding.toHom ed)
        let traceArg := fun (g : G) (t : H) =>
          g * (ConjEmbedding.toHom eβ t)⁻¹ *
            (Dot.element replyDot)
        let survives := fun (T : Set H) (g : G) =>
          {t | t ∈ T ∧ traceArg g t ∈ MonoidHom.range (ConjEmbedding.toHom eα)}
        ((∀ h : H, Set.Finite {w | Generator.multiplicationCapBasis ed w = h}) ↔ cupFinite) ∧
        (finiteFibers ↔ finiteIndex) ∧
        (∀ (T : Set H), isTransversal T → ∀ g : G, g ∈ orbit j → ¬ finiteIndex →
          Set.Infinite (survives T g)) ∧
        (∀ hf : finiteFibers,
          let p : LabelledDrawing Complex M ML :=
            LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection eα eβ ec ed
              [(1, ⟨δ, hf⟩)] ProjectionOpening.cupAndMerge
              ProjectionClosing.splitAndTrace
          ∀ (T : Set H), isTransversal T → ∀ g : G,
            ∃ ht : Set.Finite (survives T g),
              Biset.Hom.toLinearMap (eval p)
                  (Finsupp.single (Generator.mixedPair eα eβ g) 1) =
                Finset.sum (Set.Finite.toFinset ht) (fun t =>
                  Biset.pairLinear Complex
                    (Biset.induction ec) (Biset.restriction ed)
                    (Generator.traceBasis Complex eα (traceArg g t))
                    (Finsupp.single t 1))) := by
  intro conjSubgroup Kα eα eβ A B hA hB
  subst A
  subst B
  intro J σ hσ orbit M W eval crossingDot S c d hc hd hs ec ed δ s replyDot
    ML j Ls finiteIndex q finiteFibers cupFinite isTransversal traceArg survives
  -- Proposition 5.1 and the surviving-trace convention on archive p. 16
  -- (published 28 November revision p. 18). The ordinary cup test uses
  -- the index in H. The trace-filtered crossing uses the relative index in Ls.
  -- Transport the original section along the range/comap equalities before
  -- applying the supplier, so its orbit is the one at the given representative.
  obtain ⟨_, _, _, _, _, hfinite, _, hcup, hinfinite, hprojection⟩ :=
    MixedCrossingFiberMaps K H G S α β c d hα hβ hc hd hs σ hσ
  refine ⟨hcup, hfinite, hinfinite, ?_⟩
  intro hf p T hT g
  obtain ⟨ht, hcol⟩ := (hprojection hf).2 T hT g
  refine ⟨ht, ?_⟩
  -- The inverse dot in traceArg has element s⁻¹ by definition. The
  -- chosen opening and closing evaluate to the same single generator
  -- as the compact drawing, whose column the supplier computes.
  change (LabelledDrawing.expandedProjection eα eβ ec ed
    [(1, ⟨δ, hf⟩)] .cupAndMerge .splitAndTrace).interpret.eval.toLinearMap _ = _
  rw [LabelledDrawing.eval_expandProjection, MackeyCrossingProof.compact_projection]
  exact hcol

end SinglePairIdentitySupport
